entities.name: Fungus
entities.description: A creature type describing denizens that mainly thrive and feed on decaying matter, found across many planes.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Fungus creatures of Dominaria created by Thelon, who rebelled against their elven creators and spread across Sarpadia.

entities.name: Thelon
entities.description: The creator of the thallids, who infused natural fungus with green mana and used dark rites borrowed from the Order of the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: The order whose dark rites Thelon borrowed to make the thallids.

entities.name: Elves of Havenwood
entities.description: The elves for whom the thallids were first raised as food.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: The region taken over by thallids and thrulls; home of spore flowers.

entities.name: Halfdane
entities.description: A shapeshifter who took the form of a mold demon in his fight with Ayesha Tanaka and Tor Wauki.

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: A fighter who battled the shapeshifter Halfdane.

entities.name: Tor Wauki
entities.description: A fighter who battled the shapeshifter Halfdane.

entities.name: Mycoids
entities.description: Fungal creatures of the Ixalan caverns that form a gestalt under the Mycotyrant, born of an advanced fungal outbreak.

entities.name: Mycotyrant
entities.description: The single hive mind of the mycoids, who thinks of itself as one world-spanning being.

entities.name: Topizielo
entities.description: One of the Komon Winaq's primary cities in the Ixalan caverns, where the fungal outbreak began.

entities.name: Komon Winaq
entities.description: Cavern humans who, with the Oltec, fought the mycoid spread and fled.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: Scientists and people of the Core who worked with the Komon against the mycoids.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane whose caverns host the mycoids and whose surface was settled by refugees.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi whose arrival on Innistrad spawned fungal entities like the Moldgraf Scavenger.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A gothic horror plane where Emrakul's arrival corrupted local fungi.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The Ravnican guild that uses fungi for necromancy.

events.summary: Thelon creates the thallids by infusing fungus with green mana and borrowed dark rites.
events.quote: Thelon created the thallids by infusing natural fungus with green mana

events.summary: The thallids rebel against their creators and destroy their empire entirely.
events.quote: Eventually, they would rebel against their creators destroying their empire entirely.

events.summary: The shapeshifter Halfdane takes the form of a mold demon in his fight with Ayesha Tanaka and Tor Wauki.
events.quote: The shapeshifter Halfdane took the form of a mold demon during his fight with Ayesha Tanaka and Tor Wauki

events.summary: A fungal outbreak strikes Topizielo in the Ixalan caverns, the beginning of the mycoids.
Komon and Oltec humans flee the caverns for the surface, while those who remain seal off the Core.
events.quote: The Komon and Oltec in the caverns fled, finding safety outside of the caverns.

events.summary: Emrakul's arrival on Innistrad turns local fungi into threats such as the Moldgraf Scavenger.
events.quote: entities like the Moldgraf Scavenger formed from the local fungi, threatening humans

relations.note: Thelon made the thallids from fungus and green mana.
relations.quote: Thelon created the thallids by infusing natural fungus with green mana

relations.note: Mycoids are parts of the Mycotyrant's gestalt and never free of its command.
relations.quote: they will never be wholly free of the Mycotyrant's command

relations.note: The Swarm uses fungi for necromancy.
relations.quote: The Golgari Swarm from Ravnica is known to use fungi for their necromancy
